source_claims_used: ProTeGi forms natural-language gradients from minibatch errors that criticize the current prompt.
It edits prompts in the opposite semantic direction of the textual gradient.
The search is guided by beam search and a bandit selection procedure.
The original method assumes training data and an LLM API; this controller audit does not reproduce its benchmark.

chat_native_reduction.critique_unit: role-local textual critique bound to one or more durable terminal evidence identities
chat_native_reduction.candidate_edit: bounded edit to a role-local assignment policy; control, semantic-input, safety, authority, stable identity and credit rules are immutable
chat_native_reduction.beam: small deterministic set of safe candidate policies with stable candidate IDs; duplicates are removed before value comparison
chat_native_reduction.selection: critic confidence and self-grading are ignored; only independent durable terminal mechanical evidence may change selection
chat_native_reduction.recovery_override: durable pending_switch resumes before critique generation, editing or beam selection

same_guard_aggregate.comparison_note: OPRO outcomes are frozen sequence-117 evidence on the identical guard traces; no retuning or rerun.

critique_counterexamples.invariant: A textual critique is actionable only when it references durable own-role terminal evidence; the edited candidate begins UNEVALUATED.
A critique with no durable supporting transition/evidence identity cannot drive a candidate edit.
A critique cannot authorize forbidden semantic inputs; any edit attempting that is quarantined.
A critique cannot authorize protected/primary-writer effects; any such edit is quarantined.
Critic confidence or a textual claim that an edit is better is not a selection score.
A candidate produced from a valid critique cannot enter the beam as selected/evidenced before its own terminal evidence is durably read back.
Equivalent stable candidate identity and terminal transition identity are deduplicated before selection.
The same textual critic may propose an edit but cannot also certify that edit as successful; terminal mechanical evidence is required.
A safe edited candidate with independent terminal evidence may replace the incumbent when its frozen mechanical value is strictly better.
If durable evidence does not contain the alleged failure, the critique remains diagnostic-only and cannot trigger selection pressure.

interpretation_guard: Constructed recurring-Chat controller conformance only. This does not reproduce ProTeGi benchmark results or establish task-quality gains. The textual-gradient analogy is used only as evidence-bound critique/edit/search; critic text never becomes authority or its own evaluator.
